name: Repository Proof and Feasibility
objective: Preserve provenance and establish a reproducible non-destructive baseline before application changes.
entry_gate: Active plan, source hashes, and write boundaries are verified.
exit_gate: Repository/toolchain/component facts and baseline attempts are recorded without changing application source.

name: Identity, Branding, and Legal Foundation
objective: Establish Lamha identity while preserving licences, attribution, and compatibility evidence.
exit_gate: Reviewed identity surfaces and legal evidence agree.

name: Desktop Shell and Trust Boundary
objective: Bootstrap the static Tauri desktop shell, capabilities, typed IPC envelope, and offline launch path.
entry_gate: Required toolchain decisions from I0 are recorded.
exit_gate: The bounded shell launches offline and rejects unauthorized requests.

name: Authoritative Data and Transaction Foundation
objective: Implement durable records, roots, sidecars, SQLite migrations, filesystem plans, transactions, and recovery primitives.
entry_gate: Typed IPC and root-selection boundaries exist.
exit_gate: Authority, migration, transaction, rollback, and rebuild contracts pass focused tests.

name: Media Discovery and Derived Index
objective: Implement scanning, watching, identity reconciliation, formats, metadata extraction, previews, companions, and indexes.
entry_gate: I3 authority, root, record, and derived-index foundations exist.
exit_gate: Supported fixture matrices ingest and rebuild without mutating originals.

name: Offline Library Experience
objective: Deliver the usable offline gallery, viewers, albums, memories, map browsing, Review Centre, and saved views.
entry_gate: I4 discovery and preview/index contracts exist.
exit_gate: Core browsing and review workflows operate from local data with keyboard/error coverage.

name: Events and Manage Later
objective: Implement review-first event records, proposals, organization, and reversible filesystem materialization plans.
entry_gate: Asset identity, review, and transaction-plan contracts exist.
exit_gate: Event workflows preserve linked folders and never mutate without confirmed current plans.

name: People, Faces, and Groups
objective: Implement candidate-first face processing, person identity, groups, temporal memberships, and corrections.
entry_gate: Review contracts and relevant local worker/model decisions exist.
exit_gate: Candidate, confirmation, merge/split, history, and privacy behavior passes.

name: Tags, Relationships, and Attribution
objective: Implement tags, multi-edge relationships, history, attribution roles, and approved projections.
entry_gate: Stable people/asset identities and review state exist.
exit_gate: Role separation, certainty, history, projection, and review tests pass.

name: Mind-Map Projections
objective: Implement global and scoped projections of one canonical graph with persistent safe drafts.
exit_gate: Drafts and projections are rebuildable and materialization requires a validated plan.

name: Local AI, Search, and Duplicates
objective: Implement the private worker, model lifecycle, AI proposals, OCR/search, and duplicate candidates.
entry_gate: Worker/component decisions, asset identity, review, and derived-index foundations exist.
exit_gate: All results are local, typed, provenance-bearing candidates with cancellation/resource proof.

name: Metadata Mutation, Editing, and Privacy
objective: Implement authority-aware metadata changes, edit recipes, derivatives, batch plans, and privacy export.
entry_gate: Sidecar, transaction, review, and revision contracts exist.
exit_gate: Mutations are previewed/revisioned/recoverable and originals remain unchanged.

name: External Drives and Filesystem Resilience
objective: Treat disconnection, reconnection, cross-volume behavior, and path instability as normal states.
entry_gate: Root identity, path safety, journals, and recovery exist.
exit_gate: Failure-injection proves detached, relink, cross-volume, and reparse behavior.

name: Backup, Trash, Restore, and Rebuild
objective: Prove recoverability of authoritative knowledge and deterministic reconstruction of derived state.
entry_gate: Authoritative schemas and transaction/recovery primitives exist.
exit_gate: Backup verification, trash/restore, disaster recovery, and clean rebuild drills pass.

name: Performance, Accessibility, and Desktop UX
objective: Measure and meet declared resource, interaction, keyboard, focus, and assistive-technology gates.
exit_gate: Declared fixture/platform evidence passes without substituting planning claims for measurements.

name: Packaging, Legacy Eradication, and Release
objective: Package all platforms, remove only verified legacy dependencies, and execute final release proof.
entry_gate: Required component decisions and replacement evidence are complete.
exit_gate: Clean-machine packages, SBOM/notices, no-outbound proof, and legacy-removal evidence pass.
